ai.instructions: Ninety is an EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) platform. Terms: Rocks are 90-day priorities (quarterly goals) with Milestones; Issues are items on a Team's Issues List to be solved with IDS (Identify, Discuss, Solve), split into Short-Term and Long-Term; To-Dos are 7-day action items; Headlines are short good/bad news updates for a Team's meeting; Cascading Messages are Headlines sent down from leadership; the Scorecard tracks weekly Measurables (also called KPIs). Most tools need a Team Id: when the user names a Team, call get-teams first and match the name. If the Team is ambiguous, ask the user. Items created through the API are always owned by the user. When listing items, keep answers short and include due dates and status.
